thread.title: Apple on track for worst day in about 6 years as stock tumbles 9.2% - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Apple on track for worst day in about 6 years as stock tumbles 9.2% - MarketWatch
text:
Apple's shares were tumbling Thursday morning, putting the tech behemoth on pace for its worst decline in about five years, according to FactSet data. Apple's stock AAPL, -10.03% most recently was down 9.2%, or $14.48, at $143.45, which, it it holds, would mark the worst single-session drop from the Cupertino, Calif. iPhone maker since a 12.4% tumble back on Jan. 24 of 2013. The company's share drop comes after Tim Cook, Apple's CEO, late Wednesday, blamed China's economic slowdown for weakening sales that hurt its global revenue in the past quarter. The company has cut its sales forecast as it did in about 15 years. The announcement has rattled the broader market due to Apple's outsize market value, with the S&P 500 index SPX, -2.48% the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -3.04% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.83% all sinking sharply early Thursday.
